title: UXID conformance case: monotonic
description: One line of monotonic.json: one monotonic generator's calls, the draws its random source made, and the ids it emits. The delimiter is `_` and the body is lower case. Every integer is at most 2^53 - 1.

id.description: Stable case id, `monotonic/` and a slug.

compact.description: Compact time when true; it fixes the random field's width w with the size. A monotonic xs is compact.

times.description: The current time of each call, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, one per id. No time after the first is later than the last id's time.

initial_seed.description: The first id's random field, the fresh secure value, as an unsigned integer below 2^(8w).

steps.description: The step drawn for each id after the first, each from 1 to 2^(4w).

overflow_seed.description: The fresh secure value the id whose step overflows the field takes; null when no step overflows. A case overflows at most once.

expected.description: The ids the generator emits, one per call, in call order.
